column7: ADR-112 opt-out rule: security.require_mfa has a registry entry (security.insecure_disable_mfa_requirement). An explicit require_mfa: false and the upgrade grace period (grace-not-enforced) log the start-up warning and are recorded in the settings diff with a distinct value per state; enforcing-implicit and enforcing-explicit do neither. The derived-field ratchet (TestConfigSurface_DerivedFieldRatchet) no longer exempts RequireMFAImplicitDefault/RequireMFAUpgradeGrace
